cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.
